sources.note: Nothing. Introduction sec. 7 (pp. viii-ix): transcription is 'semiphonemic', fluctuation table (Danaru p ~ f etc.); no mention of stress, accent or tone anywhere. B17 Danaru entries carry no stress marks (page image checked, printed p. 27: wɛgəpʌp 'knee', mangup 'calf'). Sec. 8 notes Danaru 1sg/2sg genitive pronouns prefixed, 3sg suffixed.
